'''Green Squadron''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] based at [[Eyrie Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karatha]]. It was led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Stevan Makintay]] and included [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Hal Dallin]] and [[Dru Gifford]]. The squadron took part in an [[Raid on an Imperial supply carrier|attack]] on an Imperial [[Supply carrier/Legends|supply carrier]] when the base was low on supplies.
